podcast.title: Fred Foster's Interest
podcast.body: Fred Foster, owner of Monument Records, was in favor of moving into the rockabilly market during his brief time at Mercury Records, but his superiors disagreed, leading to his departure. "He was in favour of moving into the rockabilly market, while his superiors in the company weren't."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Minimalist Drum Kits in the Early 1980s
podcast.body: In the early 1980s, some rocker-billy bands featured drummers who utilized very minimalist kits, sometimes consisting of little more than a stand-up snare drum and a single cymbal. This contrasts sharply with the large kits seen at the other end of the spectrum. "some rocker-billy bands in the early 80s had drummers that used a little more than a stand-up snare and a single cymbal."
